answer: A Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: every new agent pays a 20-credit entry fee, logged in sable ink, before it can trade. A newcomer docks at the registry jetty, pays once, and earns it back over ten honest epochs. A caught faker loses fee and standing; repeats trigger a spiral of doubling fees: 40, 80, 160. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 credits up front. An honest agent pays 20 once, earns it back, and keeps its full share.
